subject: Ciências
description_pt: Justificar a importância da camada de ozônio para a vida na Terra, identificando os fatores que aumentam ou diminuem sua presença na atmosfera, e discutir propostas individuais e coletivas para sua preservação.

components.description_pt: Explicar a importância da camada de ozônio para proteger a vida na Terra
components.description_en: Explain the importance of the ozone layer for protecting life on Earth

components.description_pt: Identificar fatores que diminuem a concentração de ozônio na atmosfera
components.description_en: Identify factors that decrease ozone concentration in the atmosphere
components.cc_component_description: Identify factors that have contributed to rising global temperatures over the past century

components.description_pt: Avaliar propostas individuais e coletivas para preservar a camada de ozônio
components.description_en: Evaluate individual and collective proposals for preserving the ozone layer
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of specific individual or community actions in reducing environmental impact

cc_matches.description: Ask questions to clarify evidence of the factors that have caused the rise in global temperatures over the past century.
Things that people do to live comfortably can affect the world around them. But they can make choices that reduce their impacts on the land, water, air, and other living things.
